skill.name: review-loop

content.user_title: Improve Work Through Structured Review Loops
content.value_statement: First drafts often miss requirements, edge cases, or clarity problems. This skill coordinates scored reviews and targeted revisions until a quality gate is met.
actual_capabilities: Runs a worker and reviewer cycle for code, documents, specifications, and other work products.
Requests a numeric score and specific feedback from a separate reviewer context.
Applies critical and important feedback through targeted revisions.
Supports custom minimum loops, maximum loops, quality gates, and reviewer capabilities.
Reports each loop score, key feedback, final score, and completed loop count.
limitations: Requires subagent support or a separate fresh conversation for independent review.
Reviewer scores can be inconsistent when acceptance criteria are vague.
Multiple review loops increase model usage, cost, and completion time.
Human review remains necessary for security-critical or compliance-sensitive work.

use_cases.title: Harden a Feature Before Merge
use_cases.description: Review an implementation for correctness, edge cases, security issues, and maintainability before final delivery.

use_cases.title: Refine a Technical Specification
use_cases.description: Identify unclear requirements, missing tradeoffs, and implementation gaps through repeated structured critique.

use_cases.title: Polish Professional Documentation
use_cases.description: Improve structure, clarity, completeness, and audience fit while preserving the document's intended meaning.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Run review-loop on this work. Use the default quality gate and show the score and key changes after each loop.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing work product

prompt_templates.title: Implement and Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the requested feature with review-loop. Require at least two loops, use a quality gate of eight, and summarize the final result.

prompt_templates.title: Polish a Design Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this design document for completeness, feasibility, alternatives, risks, and measurable outcomes. Run up to four loops with a quality gate of nine.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use an advanced reviewer for this multi-file change. Check correctness, compatibility, security, failure modes, tests, and maintainability. Continue until gate nine or five loops.

output_examples.input: Review an API endpoint with a quality gate of eight.
output: Loop 1 of 4: Score 6/10. Missing input validation and timeout handling.
Loop 2 of 4: Score 8/10. Required fixes are complete; one naming issue remains.
Result: Quality gate met after two loops.

output_examples.input: Polish a deployment specification using three review loops.
output_examples.output: The final specification scored 9/10 after three loops. Revisions clarified rollback steps, ownership, monitoring thresholds, and failure recovery.

best_practices: Define measurable acceptance criteria before starting the first review.
Give the reviewer only the relevant work product and task-specific criteria.
Track prior feedback so later revisions do not reintroduce resolved issues.
anti_patterns: Do not use repeated review loops for trivial edits with clear automated checks.
Do not accept a high score when the reviewer provides vague or unsupported feedback.
Do not continue beyond the maximum loop count without user approval.

faq.question: What types of work can this skill review?
faq.answer: It can review code, specifications, design documents, refactors, bug fixes, infrastructure changes, tests, and professional writing.

faq.question: Does this skill require subagent support?
faq.answer: Subagent support is preferred. A separate fresh conversation can provide an independent reviewer when subagents are unavailable.

faq.question: What is the default quality gate?
faq.answer: The default gate is 8/10, with at least two loops and no more than four loops.

faq.question: Can I change the loop settings?
faq.answer: Yes. Specify the minimum loops, maximum loops, quality gate, or reviewer capability in your request.

faq.question: Will the loop always reach the target score?
faq.answer: No. Unclear requirements, weak criteria, or model limitations can prevent convergence before the maximum loop count.

faq.question: Does this replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. Human review remains important for security, compliance, architecture, and other high-impact decisions.
